headword: {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}

definitions.explanation: An educational system in which boys and girls attend separate schools or classes.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{男女別学|だんじょべつがく}だ。
examples.english: That high school has single-sex education.

examples.japanese: {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{共学|きょうがく}→共学：15412_kyougaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧よい⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The debate continues over whether single-sex or coeducation is better.

examples.japanese: {埼玉県|さいたまけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{県立|けんりつ}→県立：21885_kenritsu⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{男女別学|だんじょべつがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In Saitama Prefecture, whether to maintain single-sex education at prefectural high schools has been a long-standing topic of debate.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧ (men and women), ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate), and ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study/schooling). While most Japanese public schools are coeducational, some prefectures (notably Saitama, Gunma, and Tochigi) still have single-sex public high schools, and many private schools remain single-sex.

The opposite is {男女共学|だんじょきょうがく} (coeducation), often shortened to ⟦{共学|きょうがく}→共学：15412_kyougaku⟧.

- {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abolish sex-segregated education
- {男女別学|だんじょべつがく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{共学|きょうがく}→共学：15412_kyougaku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: from single-sex to coeducation
